selection_reason: S003 provides the complete module interface port list and signal widths, necessary to declare output register storage.
S005 defines all configuration registers with addresses, widths, and default values, needed for internal register file declaration.
S007 defines reset behavior for non-register variables like int_ack (reset to 1) and others to 0, needed for initial state of registered outputs.
S005 provides register addresses, access types (R/W) for address decode, read mux, and write strobe generation.
S006 defines control flag generation logic (cmd_int_busy, int_busy, new_cmd, we_ack) needed for combinational logic.
S008 describes write/read procedures including BD multi-cycle write conditions, essential for BD FSM next-state logic.
S005 supplies register default values required for reset sequence of configuration registers.
S007 specifies overall reset and clock scheme, including reset values for int_ack and other non-register outputs.
S008 details the multi-cycle BD write sequencing and register write update rules, needed for FSM state updates and output registration.
S003 lists all output ports with names and widths, enabling correct mapping from internal signals to module output ports.
